verdict.rationale: Dagster models pipelines as assets with declared upstream dependencies (`deps`). Ingestion sources such as Fivetran, dlt and Airbyte, and dbt models, are represented as assets, and the changelog notes that column lineage is emitted for dbt snapshots. Together these imply a dependency-based lineage model linking sources, transformation steps and tables. However, the pack never shows how a user actually views end-to-end lineage, so the 'I see' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documentation of a lineage graph view in the UI, general column-level lineage beyond dbt snapshots, and independent or hands-on corroboration of lineage visibility.
